## 1. Discovery & Translational Science

* **Antimicrobial peptide development faces key PK-ADMET gauntlet** [Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/antimicrobial-peptides-fun-and-profit)
  * Translating antimicrobial peptide hits into clinical candidates presents severe PK-ADMET and drug delivery challenges across all routes of administration.
  * Oral formulations face significant biological barriers before achieving adequate bioactivity and bioavailability.

* **Targeted protein degradation expands to TRIM ligases and GPCRs** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42989996/)
  * Emerging preclinical strategies detail the recruitment of TRIM family E3 ligases to broaden target coverage for next-generation degraders.
  * Separate translational approaches demonstrate the feasibility of applying targeted protein degradation principles to G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs).

* **Suvorexant displays opposing effects on CSF and plasma p-tau biomarkers** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.03.26367196)
  * Secondary analysis of a clinical trial evaluating suvorexant (20 mg), a dual orexin receptor antagonist, showed a reduced pT181/T181 ratio in cerebrospinal fluid over 24 hours.
  * Conversely, suvorexant treatment increased pT181/T181 ratios in plasma, alongside pathway-level alterations in extracellular proteins associated with translation.

* **Pancreatic β-cell NCK1 loss impairs insulin secretion in type 2 diabetes** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.18.739339)
  * Expression of the adaptor protein NCK1 is reduced in islets from individuals with type 2 diabetes.
  * Conditional knockout of `NCK1` in pancreatic β-cells disrupted unfolded protein response (UPR) pathways, lowered insulin gene expression and content, and impaired glucose-stimulated insulin secretion.

## 2. Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Big Pharma]** **J&J and AbbVie to showcase trispecific antibodies at ASH** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ash-2026-trispecific-multiple-myeloma-johnson-johnson-abbvie/873852/)
  * Drugmakers including Johnson & Johnson and AbbVie will present early-stage clinical trial data for novel trispecific antibodies targeting multiple myeloma at the upcoming ASH annual meeting.

* **[Biotech]** **Halted sickle cell gene editing program plans clinical re-entry** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/05/biotech-news-a-possible-comeback-for-failed-sickle-cell-gene-therapy/)
  * A sickle cell gene-editing therapy trial halted three years ago following a serious adverse event in its initial patient is advancing work toward clinical trial resumption.

* **Tumaini trial initiates to evaluate Bundibugyo virus vaccine candidates** [The Lancet](https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(26)02239-7/fulltext?rss=yes)
  * The clinical Tumaini trial has begun testing candidate vaccines against Bundibugyo virus infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

## 3. Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Tislelizumab regimen reports patient outcomes in resectable NSCLC** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42990047/)
  * Patient-reported outcomes from the phase 3 RATIONALE-315 trial evaluated perioperative tislelizumab combined with neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Servier asset fails primary endpoint in key study** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-hims-alnylam-boehringer-ultragenyx-sevasemten-ani-egetis/873843/)
  * A drug candidate recently acquired by Servier failed to achieve its primary objective in a pivotal clinical trial.

* **TOPIC-2 trial evaluates post-thoracotomy pain management strategies** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42988384/)
  * The open-label, randomized controlled TOPIC-2 trial compared thoracic epidural against paravertebral blockade for reducing chronic post-thoracotomy pain.

## 4. Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to subcutaneous Rybrevant Faspro for HNSCC** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-new-treatment-head-and-neck-squamous-cell-carcinoma)
  * The FDA granted accelerated approval to Rybrevant Faspro (amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj), administered subcutaneously, for adults with recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
  * The indication covers patients whose disease progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy and an anti-PD-(L)1 antibody.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis cites tumor cases post-Zolgensma treatment** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/05/novartis-sma-zolgensma-tumor-case-reports/)
  * Novartis acknowledged seven previously unknown cases where tumors developed in pediatric patients who had received its spinal muscular atrophy gene therapy, Zolgensma.

## 5. Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Revolution Medicines reports $198M Q3 launch for Rasonque** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/revolution-rasonque-sales-3q-2026-pancreatic-cancer/873839/)
  * Pancreatic cancer therapeutic Rasonque posted $198 million in Q3 revenue over its first five weeks on the market, driving one of the fastest commercial starts for an oncology drug.
  * Company leadership advised caution regarding long-term sales projections given the early stage of commercial deployment.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly enters GLP-1 partnership with Hims & Hers** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-hims-alnylam-boehringer-ultragenyx-sevasemten-ani-egetis/873843/)
  * Eli Lilly established a GLP-1 supply deal with telehealth provider Hims & Hers, steering the platform away from selling unbranded compounded GLP-1 products.

* **[Biotech]** **Ultragenyx initiates staff workforce reductions** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-hims-alnylam-boehringer-ultragenyx-sevasemten-ani-egetis/873843/)
  * Ultragenyx announced internal workforce reductions as part of cost-management initiatives.

* **PhRMA spent $59M on search advertising campaigns** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/05/phrma-blamed-pbms-high-drug-prices-search-ads/)
  * Industry trade organization PhRMA directed an estimated $59 million over seven years toward search engine advertising aimed at highlighting pharmacy benefit manager practices in relation to drug prices.

## 6. Public Health & Policy

* **CMS finalizes 340B payment cuts and site-neutral rules for 2027** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/medicare-will-cut-billions-from-340b-expand-site-neutral-payments-in-2027/873909/)
  * Regulators finalized a rule slated for 2027 that reduces Medicare reimbursement rates for drugs under the 340B program and expands site-neutral payments across care settings.

* **Infant deaths from measles reported across multiple US states** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/05/child-dies-measles-wisconsin-first-death-since-1990/)
  * Public health authorities reported recent infant deaths attributable to measles in Wisconsin, New York, and Pennsylvania, marking Wisconsin's first fatal measles case in 36 years.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [Jeff’s exercise graveyard | Jeff Cavaliere, M.S.P.T., C.S.C.S.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Ni9Uwvafuq8) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Jeff Cavaliere discusses "junk volume" as a major training mistake, outlining the boundary between productive reps and wasted volume.
        - Cavaliere details his approach to active rehabilitation while training around a partially torn labrum and rotator cuff, noting that complete rest can impede recovery.
        - The conversation emphasizes giving greater focus to under-targeted areas, including calves, glutes, and smaller stabilizing muscles.
        - The clip identifies midlife indicators that necessitate training adjustments, such as joint soreness, persistent fatigue, and irritability.
    - [Founders and VCs Want Different Things](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bal8HE89RGE) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Malak Atut discusses the divergence in priorities between startup founding teams and venture capital investors.
        - The video examines how conflict and misaligned goals emerge once outside capital is introduced into a business.
        - It provides perspective on navigating changing dynamic expectations between founders and VCs post-funding.
    - [Why Did America Make Healthcare This Complicated?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/P9eCF1_oVfA) -- Health2Tech
        - Alison Curfman analyzes the underlying causes behind the extreme complexity of the US health insurance system.
        - The video addresses why healthcare in America became uniquely confusing compared to other systems.
        - It explores the systemic factors that drive up costs and create administrative barriers in American healthcare.
- Pure Science
    - [Why do deserts get cold at night?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rL0qEmTRI-I) -- Veritasium
        - The video investigates the sharp thermal shift in desert environments between day and night.
        - It highlights how blistering daytime ground temperatures can plunge to freezing conditions within hours after nightfall.
        - The content addresses the environmental mechanisms responsible for these severe diurnal temperature drops.
- Other
    - [The Quest for Stardust: Crash Course Lecture](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FcY4QW_lyYo) -- CrashCourse
        - Citizen scientist Jon Larsen spent a decade using magnets to collect dust worldwide, searching for micrometeorites despite initial scientific skepticism.
        - The lecture explores the methodology of locating urban stardust and isolating extraterrestrial particles from terrestrial pollution.
        - It discusses how analyzing cosmic dust provides clues regarding the dynamic universe and the origin of life on Earth.
        - The video emphasizes the valuable contributions curious amateurs and non-traditional researchers can make to scientific fields like geology.
- To watch
    - [How North Korea Pulled Off the Biggest Heist in History](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yU8JpuK5NZs) -- Patrick Boyle
